newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Poongsan unit PMX $100 mln FRN allotted.
newsitem.headline: Poongsan unit PMX $100 mln FRN allotted.

text.p: PMX Industries Inc's US$100 million guaranteed floating rate note issue has been closed, said bookrunner DKB Asia.
The five-year notes, guaranteed by Poongsan Corp, have a put and call option in year three. They were issued at par to float at 80 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 110 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers are KDB Asia, with US$22 million, and DKB Asia, Hanil International Finance and LTCB Asia, with US$11 million each.
Co-lead managers are Sumitomo Trust Finance HK, with US$10 million, Commercial Bank of Korea's Singapore branch, with US$8 million, and Industrial Bank of Korea's Hong Kong branch, with US$7 million.
Senior manager LG Merchant Banking Corp committed US$5 million.
Managers, with US$3 million each, are Daedong Bank, Kangwon Bank, Kookmin Bank Singapore (Merchant Bank), Korea Long-Term Credit Bank's Singapore branch and Seoul (Asia) Finance.
